data.title: Ocean Star
data.about:
Discover the serene elegance of Ocean Star, situated in the heart of Rashid Yachts & Marina. This EMAAR Ocean Star development seamlessly merges the serene allure of waterfront living with the dynamic essence of Dubai. 

Offering a diverse array of residences, Ocean Star caters to every lifestyle.  Select from 1 to 3 Bedroom Apartments, ensuring a life of unparalleled luxury and convenience. Embrace daily luxury at Ocean Star, where every moment is an indulgence in the finer aspects of life, surrounded by sophisticated architecture that blends traditional elegance with contemporary flair.

Living at Ocean Star within EMAAR Ocean Star apartments means more than just enjoying a beautiful home; it means being part of a lifestyle that epitomizes tranquility and luxury. Positioned within Rashid Yachts & Marina, the development offers a unique living experience, combining the tranquility of marina life with the vibrancy of Dubai. The convenience of an on-site health clinic and proximity to educational facilities enhances your living experience, ensuring everything you need is within easy reach. Ocean Star stands as a testament to Dubai's visionary approach, offering a lifestyle that's both opulent and serene, perfectly balanced between nature and urban living.

location_tile.title: An Ideal Location at Ocean Star Rashid Yachts and Marina
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
EMAAR Ocean Star Apartments, nestled within the luxurious Ocean Star Rashid Yachts & Marina, present an ideal fusion of natural beauty and urban sophistication. These homes boast lush terraces and abundant greenery, transforming your outdoor moments into unforgettable experiences. Living in Ocean Star means having Dubai’s iconic sights as an extension of your living space, where the tranquility of waterfront habitation meets the excitement of the city’s bustling commercial areas.

The waterfront promenade at Rashid Yachts & Marina is a bustling center of marina life, alive with activity both day and night. Here, a blend of exquisite dining options and chic shopping venues crafts a refined atmosphere. The marina, a recent addition to Rashid Yachts & Marina, ensures easy access to the heart of Dubai.

  • 10 min to Sheikh Zayed Road
  • 15 min to Dubai International Airport
  • 20 min to Downtown Dubai
  • 20 min to the Dubai Mall/Burj Khalifa
  • 20 min to Dubai Creek Harbour
